Los Angeles, California · stay

Hotels in Los Angeles for cyclists

Where to sleep in Los Angeles when you’re here to ride. Book early for event weekends.

Hotels in Los Angeles for cyclists, listed

1 with a bike policy in writing · 5 to ask.

  1. HI Los Angeles Santa Monica Hostel

    Downtown Santa Monica, 0.4 mile from the pier by its own page.

    • 1436 2nd Street, Santa Monica, CA 90401
    • $
    • Bike: Free bicycle storage at the hostel (its words). E-bikes only if UL- or EN 15194-certified; nothing charges inside the building.
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about HI Los Angeles Santa Monica Hostel

    The beach path passes the pier. The one place this run found with the bike policy in writing. Beds from $35 (HI’s site, Sept 2026); dorms of 4 to 10 and private rooms; elevator, kitchen, lockers; check-in 3, out 11. No parking: the P6 structure across the street is $20 to $25 a day, Civic Center $5 to $14 and a 10-minute walk.

  2. Inn at Venice Beach

    Washington Blvd in Venice, two blocks from the sand by its own page.

    • 327 Washington Boulevard, Venice, CA 90292
    • Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book
    BookDirectionsWebsite
    More about Inn at Venice Beach

    The beach path runs on-street along Washington here, so you roll out the door onto it. Nothing about your own bike on the inn’s page; the chain page says Pacifica Hotels “invites you (and your bike)” and rents bikes. No rate shown (Sept 2026).

  3. The Ambrose Hotel

    • 1255 20th Street, Santa Monica, CA 90404
    • Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book
    BookDirectionsWebsite
    More about The Ambrose Hotel

    Mid-city Santa Monica on 20th St, the nearest hotel this run found to 26th and San Vicente, where Velo Club La Grange’s weekday rides (Tue, Wed, Thu and Fri, 6:30 am) leave. Beach cruisers to borrow “based on availability,” per the page; nothing about your own bike. No rate shown (Sept 2026).

  4. Kimpton Hotel Palomar Los Angeles Beverly Hills

    • 10740 Wilshire Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90024
    • Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Kimpton Hotel Palomar Los Angeles Beverly Hills

    Wilshire Blvd in Westwood, the same ZIP as Raymond Fouquet Square, the start of La Grange’s Nichols Canyon ride (Sundays, 8:00 am). No bike line on the page. No rate shown; self-parking $55 a day, valet $77 (Sept 2026).

  5. Kimpton Everly Hotel

    Hollywood, below the hills.

    • 1800 Argyle Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90028
    • Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book
    DirectionsWebsite
    More about Kimpton Everly Hotel

    Griffith Park is the near end of a ride from here. No bike line on the page. No rate shown; valet parking $75 plus tax a night (Sept 2026).

  6. Sea Sprite Beach Club

    On the Strand in Hermosa Beach.

    • 1016 The Strand, Hermosa Beach, CA 90254
    • $$$
    • Bike: No stated policy — ask when you book
    BookDirectionsWebsite
    More about Sea Sprite Beach Club

    The Strand is the beach path here, and the page says “direct access to The Strand’s 22-mile oceanfront path.” South, the path leaves the sand at First Ave for the roll to Redondo Pier and the start of the Donut Ride (Saturdays, 8:00 am). The page’s only bike line is about rentals. Starting rate $287 (Sept 2026), after a 2025 remodel.
